content_sections.heading: Latur DC Aaple Sarkar Seva Kendra Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must satisfy all of the following conditions to be considered eligible: Minimum age of 18 years. Minimum qualification: passed Higher Secondary School Certificate (12th / H.S.C.) examination. Basic computer knowledge is required; candidates holding an MSCIT or CCC certificate will be given preference. Must be a local resident of the concerned Gram Panchayat / Nagar Parishad / Nagar Panchayat / Municipal Corporation area applied for. Must possess Aadhaar card, PAN card, a bank account, and other necessary documents. Must not have been convicted of moral turpitude, financial fraud, or cyber crime.

content_sections.heading: Latur DC Aaple Sarkar Seva Kendra Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is based on a 100-mark evaluation criteria, decided by the District-level Setu Committee headed by the District Collector, when more than one application is received for the same geographic area. The Setu Prabhari Officer and District Social Welfare Officer jointly conduct scrutiny; the committee's decision is final. Preliminary scrutiny of documents attached with the application; list of eligible/ineligible applicants published. Objections invited on the eligible/ineligible list; final eligible/ineligible list published after deciding objections (separate schedule published independently). Physical inspection of shortlisted applicants' office premises for infrastructure facilities, by inspection teams (separate schedule published independently). Interview schedule published separately after the infrastructure inspection. District-level Selection Committee publishes a merit list based on the 100-mark evaluation. Objections invited on the preliminary selection list (separate schedule published independently). Final selection list published after deciding on objections received.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for Latur DC Aaple Sarkar Seva Kendra Application
content_sections.text: Domicile/residence certificate from the Gram Sevak / Commissioner / Chief Officer of the concerned Gram Panchayat / Municipal Corporation / Municipal Council / Nagar Panchayat area (mandatory) Proof of minimum age 18 years (TC copy / school leaving certificate / school exam certificate, etc.) Aadhaar card and PAN card copies Educational documents (12th pass, degree, postgraduate certificates, as applicable) MSCIT or CCC certificate Self-attested bank account statement for the last 6 months Character certificate from the concerned police station for the current month (if unavailable, the acknowledgement receipt of the application submitted for it must be attached, but the original certificate must be produced before the interview) GPS-camera photographs of the interior and exterior of the proposed Aaple Sarkar Seva Kendra location CSC (Common Service Centre) certificate, if already held Proof of differently-abled / ex-servicemen / self-help group / local entrepreneur status, if applicable If premises are self-owned: ownership documents (house tax receipt 2025–26 onward, or Gram Panchayat Form No. 8); if owned by a relative: self-declaration of relationship along with the owner's house tax receipt (2025–26 onward) or Gram Panchayat Form No. 8 If premises are rented: rent agreement / notarised rent deed Receipt of the Rs. 500/- application fee paid online from the applicant's own bank account

faq.question: Q1. What is Latur DC Aaple Sarkar Seva Kendra Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is an online application process, opened by the District Collector Office, Latur, to select operators for 640 vacant Aaple Sarkar Seva Kendra locations across Latur district.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: 640 vacant Aaple Sarkar Seva Kendra locations - 599 in Gram Panchayat areas, 10 in Nagar Parishad/Nagar Panchayat areas, and 31 in Latur City Municipal Corporation wards.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for Latur DC Aaple Sarkar Seva Kendra Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: 15 September 2026, up to 5:00 PM. Applications must be submitted online at setusamitilatur.in.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed the 12th (H.S.C.) examination and have basic computer knowledge; an MSCIT or CCC certificate is preferred.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: A minimum age of 18 years is required. No maximum age limit is specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there an application fee for Latur DC Aaple Sarkar Seva Kendra Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes, Rs. 500/-, payable online via QR code from the applicant's own bank account.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for Latur DC Aaple Sarkar Seva Kendra Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online at setusamitilatur.in, upload the required documents, pay the Rs. 500/- fee, and submit before 15 September 2026, 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for Latur DC Aaple Sarkar Seva Kendra?
faq.answer: Selection is based on a 100-mark evaluation covering education, computer literacy, infrastructure, financial capacity, an interview, experience, business plan, social inclusiveness, and character verification, followed by a District-level Selection Committee merit list.
